_note: A path-shaped `types` entry is inherited as written, and TypeScript resolves it against the directory of the root config it compiles. Under svelte-check that root is its overlay in `.svelte-check/`, where `./worker-configuration.d.ts` does not exist: tsgo prints a TS2688 with no file or position and abandons the program, so the assignability error in the component is never reported. svelte-check --tsgo 4.7.7 reports only the TS2688, on the project tsconfig at 1:1. Our overlay re-anchors the entry on svelte-check's overlay directory so it fails the same way.
